WeCP AI Interviewer FAQs
How does the AI Interviewer fit into our existing hiring process?
It replaces manual, inconsistent early-stage screening (resume reviews, phone screens, first-rounds) with a consistent, scalable, and objective evaluation of every candidate.
How does it ensure fairness, reduce bias, and comply with hiring regulations?
WeCP applies structured rubrics and standardized scoring, reducing unconscious bias. The AI Interviewer complies with EEOC, GDPR, and CPRA, with audit-ready logs available for compliance reviews. This provides leaders with confidence that hiring practices scale without legal risk.
How do we know candidates aren’t misrepresenting themselves in AI-led screenings?
The AI focuses on structured knowledge and skill-based questioning that is harder to fake than a résumé. It captures depth, reasoning, and clarity in responses. For higher-stakes integrity checks (deepfakes, impersonation, proctoring), enterprises can layer Sherlock separately.
What is the candidate’s experience like?
Candidates interact through a natural, conversational interface - just like a real human interviewer, but without scheduling bottlenecks. They’re greeted warmly, guided through the interview flow, and given space to share their experiences. This makes the process faster, fairer, and more accessible.
What kind of reports do recruiters and hiring managers receive?
Recruiters receive concise reports with candidate transcripts, interview clips, key highlights, and structured scores on skills, knowledge, and role alignment. This helps them quickly identify the top candidates to advance, without having to review every full conversation.
How does the AI Interviewer integrate into our current stack / ATS?
It plugs into leading ATS systems (e.g., Greenhouse, Workday, Ashby) and calendar tools for smooth scheduling. Reports flow back into your ATS, so recruiters can manage everything in one place without switching platforms.
How secure is candidate data, and who owns it?
Candidate data belongs to your organization. All transcripts and reports are encrypted in transit and at rest, retention is configurable, and the platform complies with enterprise-grade standards like ISO, SOC2, GDPR, and CPRA.
Can the AI Interviewer handle high-volume hiring, like campus or entry-level roles?
Absolutely. The AI Interviewer is designed for scale. It can screen hundreds or thousands of candidates in parallel - a task that would overwhelm recruiter bandwidth - while still providing structured reports for each candidate.
How much time can recruiters save with the AI Interviewer?
Recruiters save hours per role by eliminating manual résumé reviews and phone screens. Instead of talking to every applicant, they receive pre-screened, high-potential candidates to advance — compressing hiring cycles significantly. Check our "AI Interviewer ROI Calculator"
How does this support TA leaders at the department or enterprise level?
TA leaders gain consistent, unbiased screening across all roles and geographies, reducing risk of mis-hires. The AI Interviewer ensures that recruiters and managers focus only on serious candidates, improving hiring quality and helping teams scale hiring without adding headcount.
